name: easel-pixel
description: Preview: pixel art in your own Aseprite (optional; a paid app), not yet tested end to end with a real Aseprite; not affiliated with Aseprite or Igara Studio. While it runs, its local bridge accepts commands, Lua included, from any program on this computer: only the run_lua MCP tool is off.

aseprite_path.title: Aseprite program (optional)
aseprite_path.description: Only needed for headless mode, or if Aseprite is not found: the full path to Aseprite.exe (or the aseprite program). Leave empty otherwise.

headless.title: Headless mode
headless.description: Draw with a batch Aseprite and no window (saves files only). Off by default: you watch the sprite in your open Aseprite window.
